summary.text: Sanjeev Manohar is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 9, where he assumed office on December 4, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A chemical engineer, he lists defending democracy, lowering costs and public schools among his key campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: Sanjeev K. Manohar earned a graduate degree from Southern Illinois University, Carbondale in 1986 and a Ph.D. from the University of Pennsylvania in 1992.
His career experience includes working as a chemical engineer, and he has been affiliated with the American Institute of Chemical Engineers and the American Chemical Society.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Manohar described himself as a scientist and engineer who has lived in Nashua for 18 years, has been a software startup founder and CEO, and served as vice president of a faculty union.
He listed three key messages: defending democracy and freedoms, lowering costs and growing the economy, and supporting public schools.
